script.text: On the second day of the ARC League Championship, Yuya had his long-awaited rematch with Sylvio.
Yuya Sakaki and Sylvio Sawatari, report to the center duel court!
Yuya Sakaki… For all of the defeats… And disrespect… It's payback time! If you think Pendulum Cards are going to save you, think again!
Can it be that Sylvio has Pendulum Cards of his own now?
